+"""Generate a low, side-contact push around the left end of the wall."""
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+import mw_tool
+
+
+def main():
+    s = mw_tool.Session("/app/instance.npz")
+
+    def step(a):
+        s.step(np.asarray(a, dtype=float))
+
+    def move_mocap(target, settle=8):
+        target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
+        for _ in range(100):
+            delta = target - s.data.mocap_pos[0].copy()
+            if np.max(np.abs(delta)) < 1e-9:
+                break
+            xyz = np.clip(delta / 0.01, -1, 1)
+            step([*xyz, -1])
+        for _ in range(settle):
+            step([0, 0, 0, -1])
+
+    # Start to the right of the puck, with the forward finger aligned to its centre.
+    obj = s.state()["object_pos"]
+    move_mocap([obj[0] + 0.07, obj[1] - 0.05, 0.25])
+    move_mocap([obj[0] + 0.07, obj[1] - 0.05, 0.05], settle=10)
+
+    # Move the puck left of the wall. Its centre needs to clear x=-0.04.
+    for _ in range(60):
+        if s.state()["object_pos"][0] < -0.075:
+            break
+        step([-1, 0, 0, -1])
+    for _ in range(10):
+        step([0, 0, 0, -1])
+
+    # Lift over the wall, then line the finger up behind the puck for a forward push.
+    move_mocap([s.data.mocap_pos[0, 0], s.data.mocap_pos[0, 1], 0.25])
+    obj = s.state()["object_pos"]
+    move_mocap([obj[0], obj[1] - 0.06, 0.25])
+    move_mocap([obj[0], obj[1] - 0.06, 0.05], settle=10)
+
+    # Pass the north edge of the wall before shifting back toward the goal.
+    for _ in range(100):
+        if s.state()["object_pos"][1] >= 0.84:

+        step([0, 1, 0, -1])
+    for _ in range(10):
+        step([0, 0, 0, -1])
+
+    # At y=.84 the puck is clear of the wall. Push it right toward the target.
+    move_mocap([s.data.mocap_pos[0, 0], s.data.mocap_pos[0, 1], 0.25])
+    obj = s.state()["object_pos"]
+    move_mocap([obj[0] - 0.07, obj[1] - 0.05, 0.25])
+    move_mocap([obj[0] - 0.07, obj[1] - 0.05, 0.05], settle=10)
+    for _ in range(100):
+        if s.state()["object_pos"][0] >= 0.025:
+            break
+        step([1, 0, 0, -1])

+    print("replay", replay)
